correctness.rationale: Narrowed headline verified by fully independent replay (own facet/point/width/Ehrhart code, not the candidate scripts). All 55 candidates (23 boxed + 32 spiked): facet sets, 7-point sets, interior sets, hollow flags, stored attainers achieving stored widths, and dilate counts L(2),L(3) with h3*=L3-4L2+6L1-4 cross-check all agree with certs (boxed 23=8 hollow width-2 h3*=0 + 15 one-interior-point width-2 h3*=1; spiked 32=2 hollow q1,q2 width-2 + 30 non-hollow with interior 1-3, including one width-3 non-hollow q4 with 2 interior points). Width minima re-proved by independently recomputed adjugate boxes with an enlarged (+2) margin: minima equal stored widths in all 55 cases. All 45 pairwise affine-unimodular incongruence searches among the hollow 10 rerun with independent exhaustive ordered-basis search: all False. Totals and artifact pointers match. Non-claims are explicit (merged branch excluded, W7* left open as 2-or-3, no hollow width-3 witness, representatives not canonical). Conditional on the listed/generated inputs, every essential inference, boundary recount, and computation holds; proof vs computation is distinguished (certificates are computational, correctly so).

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively: Blanco-Santos 1501.01055 fixes the 6-point boundary (74 width-2, 2 width-3, 4 hollow) but no hollow-7 statement; Blanco-Santos 1601.02577 publishes the overall size-7 width>1 enumeration (496 classes: 477 width-2, 19 width-3) plus the boxed/spiked/merged taxonomy and ancillary boxed matrices, but no hollow-stratified size-7 maximum, attainer list, or boxed/spiked hollow-subset census with widths; Codenotti-Santos 1812.00916 conjectures 2+sqrt(2) for 3D hollow bodies rather than settling any 7-point lattice stratum. No inspected source publishes the exact claim audited here (8 boxed hollow + 2 spiked hollow among the two quasi-minimal size-7 lists, all width 2, pairwise inequivalent, with full negative logs). The vertex matrices overlap published ancillary data by design, but the hollow/width/inequivalence labels over these lists are not stated in the priors and are not mechanically implied by the overall max-3 (overall max does not fix the hollow-stratified outcome). Priority is established by substantive comparison, not by timestamp or failed search.

value.rationale: Judging the strongest actually-established headline separately from the admitted W7*=3 target: what is proved is a fragmentary subcensus -- ten hollow width-2 classes across two quasi-minimal branches (8 boxed of 23 listed; 2 spiked of 32 generated), pairwise inequivalent, with the merged branch explicitly unenumerated and W7* left open (2 or 3). This lacks every feature that made the pre-registered target independently retrievable: no sharp maximum, no width-3 (or any) new extremal witness (all ten have width 2, the modal size-7 value; the sole width-3 member q4 is non-hollow), no width-frequency table over H7, no no-width>=4 gap certificate, and no proved spiked-branch structural lemma (only a finite-list width check, in fact =2). The Codenotti-Santos 'consistency' corollary is vacuous (2 < 3.414 constrains nothing and implies nothing for the conjecture). A future researcher needing H7 cannot use or cite this fragment without the dominant merged branch and would simply rerun the seconds-scale filter over the full 496-class census; the ten labels are not known to be needed as a precise standalone fact. Honest scoping to the two lists preserves correctness but leaves a literature-artifact slice (listed/generated quasi-minimal candidates) rather than a natural-object invariant of H7. Certification depth and negative logs do not rescue an arbitrary-scope fragment with no extremal, structural, or census-complete payoff. It falls short even of the pre-registered fallback (boxed+merged subcensus plus width-3 witness plus spiked lemma). Missing substantive result with intrinsically low retrieval value.
